title: Resolving definition references in callable union discriminators
answers: Why does Field(discriminator=...) fail on a PEP 695 TypeAliasType union?
How to resolve definition-ref schemas in Discriminator._convert_schema when handler is None?
Fixing MissingDefinitionForUnionRef with callable discriminators and type aliases
body:
Symptom: Callable discriminator on a Field fails to resolve union variants when applied to a PEP 695 type alias (TypeAliasType) or definition-ref schema.
Root cause: pydantic/types.py:Discriminator._convert_schema only resolved definition-ref schemas using handler.resolve_ref_schema, but pydantic/_internal/_discriminated_union.py:apply_discriminator calls _convert_schema without a handler and omitted definitions.
Fix pattern: Pass definitions to _convert_schema from apply_discriminator and resolve definition-ref schemas via handler.resolve_ref_schema when handler is present, or definitions.get(schema_ref) when definitions is present.
Constraints: Applies to definition-ref resolution in discriminated union conversion; raises MissingDefinitionForUnionRef if the definition reference cannot be resolved.
applies: Discriminated union conversion for callable discriminators and definition-ref schemas in Pydantic models.
